steps.label: 03 Lakeflow
steps.sub: Declarative transform with inline data quality

code:
Catalog: retail_prod
├── Schema: bronze   (raw landed data)
├── Schema: silver    (cleaned, deduplicated)
├── Schema: gold      (business-ready, joined)
└── Volume: raw_landing  (daily catalog export lands here)
caption: Managed tables throughout — nothing here needs external tables.

code:
Order events (streaming): Auto Loader + Structured Streaming,
                          directory listing -- volume doesn't
                          yet justify file notification mode

Product catalog (daily): Auto Loader trigger-once batch mode,
                          schema evolution allows new columns
caption: Two ingestion problems, two configurations.
A bad total gets dropped; a missing customer ID gets tracked, not dropped.

code:
Task 1: ingest_catalog_batch   (Auto Loader, daily trigger)
Task 2: run_lakeflow_pipeline  (depends on Task 1)
Task 3: refresh_gold_metrics   (depends on Task 2)
Task 4: notify_on_failure      (runs only on failure)
caption: Streaming order ingestion runs as its own separate job.

code:
Performance: broadcast join candidate + liquid clustering
             on order_date for fast time-range queries

Security:    column mask on customer_email, managed identity
             auth, audit logging enabled on the catalog
caption: Provably secure enough for an auditor to sign off on.
